newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks open mixed in light trading.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks open mixed in light trading.

text.p: CHANGE CHANGE
NIKKEI 18352.14 +258.73 LME CASH NICKEL US$7255 +45.0
CANDLR 1.4005 LME CASH ALUM US$1524.5 +4.5
CAN 30-YR 108.57 -0.03 BRENT CRUDE US$18.00 +0.31
* Toronto stocks opened mixed in thin dealings but nearly all of 14 sub-indices firmer. * Natural resource issues active.
* 7.7 million shares traded worth C$90 million.
Toronto stocks opened mixed in quiet dealings on Friday, buoyed by New York's strength after higher than forecast earnings by U.S. software giant Microsoft Corp.

"The big news that is probably propelling the market is the big news Microsoft reported," said Maison Placements Canada trader Rolie Bradley. Microsoft said third-quarter earnings jumped 85 percent and net income rose to US$0.79 a share versus year earlier US$0.44, substantially above Wall Street estimates.
Otherwise, it's "bit of a directionless market," Bradley added.
Trading was even more quiet on Friday than earlier this week, another trader said.
Of Toronto's 14 sub-indices, nine rose while five dipped. Base metals, conglomerates and golds gained ground while media and consumer products slipped.
Advancers outnumbered losers 214 to 161 while 195 traded flat.
--- HOT STOCKS ---
* Rio Algom Ltd jumped 1.50 to 54.00 on more than six million shares, topping Toronto's most actives.
* Bre-X Minerals Ltd rose 0.05 to 2.35 in active dealings, adding to the interest in natural resource issues.
((Lydia Zajc, Reuters Toronto Bureau (416) 941-8109))
